title: Network Engineer-Senior Manager level
description:
Role: Network Engineer\-Senior Manager level
   

  

 Experience: 15\+ years
   

  

 Location: Bidadi, Karnataka \- 5 days WFO
   

  

* Hands on working with connected / IoT network experts
* Exp: 15\+ years
* Qualifications : Min Bachelors of Engineering (E\&C, Computer science or related )
* Experience in Network Architecture , Security
* Technical documentation
* Service Provider management ( Network package planning, usage monitoring, Contract negotiation )
* Management reporting
* Coordination with overseas network team ( Japan)


 Place of work : on site at TKM Bidadi office
   

  

**The Ideal Candidate Shall Perform The Following Activities**
* Network Coordination and Configuration Verification
* Coordinate with the LMNO Network Team for all network\-related activities.
* Verify network connectivity between interconnected systems and platforms.
* Review and validate network configurations implemented at the LMNO side.
* Document configuration discrepancies and coordinate corrective actions.
* Facilitate communication between all stakeholders regarding network readiness.
* LMNO Network Audit
* Conduct a comprehensive audit of the LMNO network environment.
* Review network architecture, routing, firewall policies, and connectivity parameters.
* Validate compliance with agreed network design and operational requirements.
* Identify risks, gaps, and optimization opportunities.
* Provide an audit report with observations and recommendations.
* End\-to\-End Testing Support
* Support planning and execution of End\-to\-End (E2E) testing activities.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure test readiness.
* Monitor network performance during testing cycles.
* Assist in troubleshooting and resolving connectivity and configuration issues identified during testing.
* Maintain testing issue logs and track resolution status.
* Network Issue Resolution Coordination
* Coordinate with TMC/KDDI teams for investigation and resolution of network\-related issues.
* Facilitate technical discussions among stakeholders.
* Track incidents, escalation requirements, and resolution timelines.
* Ensure timely closure of network issues impacting project milestones.
* SIM Activation and CAF Management
* Manage SIM activation requests and associated processes.
* Coordinate Customer Application Form (CAF) documentation and validation.
* Track activation status and resolve activation\-related issues.
* Maintain records of activated SIMs and CAF submissions.
* Project Schedule Management
* Update and maintain the master project schedule.
* Consult with project stakeholders to obtain progress updates.
* Track milestones, dependencies, risks, and delays.
* Communicate schedule updates and impacts to relevant teams.
* LMNO Platform Migration Support
* Support migration planning and execution for LMNO platforms.
* Coordinate migration activities among stakeholders.
* Verify service availability and connectivity before and after migration.
* Monitor migration progress and assist in issue management.
* Ensure migration activities are completed according to the approved implementation plan.
* Technical Support and Test Result Analysis
* Provide technical support throughout testing and migration phases.
* Analyze test results and identify issues impacting performance or functionality.
* Coordinate corrective actions with relevant teams.
* Provide technical reports and recommendations based on test outcomes.


**Deliverables**
**The Following Deliverables Shall Be Provided**
* Network Configuration Verification Report.
* LMNO Network Audit Report.
* End\-to\-End Testing Support Documentation and Issue Tracking Log.
* Network Incident and Resolution Tracker.
* SIM Activation and CAF Status Report.
* Updated Master Project Schedule.
* Migration Support and Completion Report.
* Technical Support and Test Result Analysis Report.
* Weekly/Periodic Progress Reports.
